_text: [playful] You just say: "Pass the *bread*." [dramatic] Friday night, Tyler writes PROM? across the sky with a *jet*. [urgent] Zoe's about to say yes. And you're standing in the parking lot with one bag of *bread*. [dramatic, alarmed] Tyler sees it, laughs, and *sneezes*. [panicked] Your bread blasts across the whole *town*. [building excitement] Then you hear it. *Quack*. [building excitement] The ducks follow the bread. The kids follow the ducks. The parents follow the *kids*. [excited, building] The news van follows the parents. And they're all following *you*. [dramatic, booming] Ten feet. Fifty. Three hundred. *Nine hundred*. [triumphant] You're eye to eye with Tyler. Actually, he's looking *up*. [smug, playful] You lean down: "Hey, Tyler. Need a *ladder*?" [warm, excited] Then you kneel down to Zoe, with four-thousand ducks behind you. [relieved, overjoyed] She says *yes*. [amused] And the duck? Still your number one *follower*.
